NewsArticle.Title: Contact Forms Available
NewsArticle.Content: 01.19 10:30 a.m. pst Dark Ages contact suggestion, feedback, and bug report forms are available at [www.darkages.com/contact](http://www.darkages.com/contact). Previously they may have displayed an error such as "A connection with the server could not be established." Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
